verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is that Copilot configures "automations" from plain-English requests. That implies the product has a native automation feature, but nothing describes triggers or actions. Zapier and sequenced email campaigns are third-party or adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented trigger types (record or stage changes), record-update actions, automatic task-creation actions, notification actions, a workflow builder description, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests
